title: US Starbucks workers prepare to strike if contract is not finalized by next week
summary: Starbucks Workers United voted to authorize open-ended strike if deal with company is not reached by 13 NovemberUnionizedStarbucksbaristas voted to authorize an open-ended strike ahead of Starbucks’s high-traffic holiday season, announced Starbucks Workers United on Wednesday.The union said workers are prepared to strike if a contract is not finalized by 13 November, which is the company’s Red Cup Day, and strike actions could hit more than 25 cities and escalate if there is a lack of progress.Continue reading...

title: Dow, S&P 500 Mark 4-Day Losing Streaks as Investors Shun AI Trade
summary: Stocks spent Tuesday in the dumpster, with the S&P 500 and the Dow each marking four-day losing streaks.  Semiconductor stocks got badly hit–as did equities tied to the AI trade.  The S&P 500 fell 0.8%, but nearly 300 of the index’s components, or 60% of stocks, ended the day higher.

title: I kept blowing trading accounts because I couldn’t stop myself from trading
summary: I’ve blown more trading accounts than I want to admit.Every time I told myself “just one more trade” and every time it ended the same way, blowing account after account which sucked so much. What finally clicked for me was realizing I don’t lose money because I don’t know setups, I lose money because I trade when I shouldn’tI ended up building a simple web app that forces me to explain why I’m taking a trade before I can take it. If my reasoning is emotional, it locks me outIt’s been helping me stay out of bad trades. Sharing in case it helps someone else:https://impulseaiapp.comsubmitted by/u/SethBright[link][comments]
